data.one_liner: A shelf handler for proxying HTTP requests to another server.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Shelf handler that proxies incoming HTTP requests to an external server. It can be served directly as a standalone proxy server or mounted within a larger Shelf application to proxy specific URLs.
use_when: You are building a backend server using Shelf and need to proxy requests to an external server.
You want to mount a proxy handler for specific URLs within a larger Shelf application.
avoid_when: You are not using Shelf for your backend routing.
You need a full-featured API gateway with complex routing rules and transformation capabilities beyond simple proxying.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the Shelf ecosystem.
Can be used standalone or mounted within larger applications.
Correctly handles multiple Cookie and Set-Cookie headers.
weaknesses: Basic proxying capabilities without advanced middleware features built-in.
